covered_security_controls: Removal of shell execution from lookup path
Static Jinja template with variable binding
HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and conditional Secure cookie attributes

runtime_environment.network: DNS resolution mocked to confirm rejected payloads do not call lookup

limitations: No broad repository scan was performed by design.
Runtime DB verification used sqlite; non-sqlite placeholder behavior was statically reviewed.
Representative HTML-injection paths were retested; no exhaustive XSS fuzzing was performed.
Secure cookie flag depends on HTTPS request context through request.is_secure.
